fields.name: year
fields.description: Year for monthly ephemeris (1551 to 2649). Defaults to the current year (UTC).

fields.name: month
fields.description: Month number (1-12) for ephemeris. Defaults to the current month (UTC).

fields.name: coordinateSystem
fields.description: Coordinate system for longitude output. "sidereal" (Nirayana) uses Lahiri ayanamsa, the standard for Vedic astrology. "tropical" (Sayana) uses raw ecliptic longitude matching Western astrology. Defaults to "sidereal".
